sex_hormones.name: Sex hormones
sex_hormones.blurb: Gonadal, adrenal and pituitary hormones that govern reproduction, androgen and estrogen status, and ovarian reserve; most vary strongly with sex, age and, in women, cycle phase.

thyroid.name: Thyroid
thyroid.blurb: The pituitary-thyroid axis that sets metabolic rate, read as TSH plus the free thyroid hormones it controls.

cardiometabolic.name: Cardiometabolic
cardiometabolic.blurb: Lipoproteins, glucose and insulin markers that track atherosclerotic risk and insulin resistance, where population averages are often well above healthy levels.

iron.name: Iron
iron.blurb: Measures of iron stores and iron in transit that together distinguish deficiency, inflammation and overload.
